prompt.en: Send each watcher back to where it was watching from.
prompt.ar: أَعِدْ كُلَّ مُرَاقِبٍ إِلَى المَكَانِ الَّذِي كَانَ يُرَاقِبُ مِنْه.

hint2.en: It belongs in one of these two.
hint2.ar: إِنَّهُ يَنْتَمِي إِلَى وَاحِدٍ مِنْ هَذَيْن.

model.en: This is where it goes. Now you try.

success.en: Every watcher is home, and every one is pointing the same way.
success.ar: عَادَ كُلُّ مُرَاقِبٍ إِلَى مَكَانِه، وَكُلُّهُمْ يُشِيرُونَ إِلَى الاِتِّجَاهِ نَفْسِه.

payload._comment: activeAttribute is the ONE thing being taught. heldConstant records what deliberately does not vary, because young children attend to the most salient attribute even when it is irrelevant - teaching 'sort by habitat' while sizes also differ risks teaching size instead. That claim is now enforced by test, which is what caught the original cast: it paired three small animals with a lion, so size varied exactly as the comment promised it would not. The cast here - monkey, bird, rabbit, fish - is all size=small, and is the same four watchers the child met in the two nodes before this one.
